features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
features.note: The reference describes a housing for a suction aid and a separate handle on the power tool, but not a grip portion of the suction aid housing itself designed as a hollow body for gripping.

features.item: An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.note: The suction aid housing does not contain a vacuum generating device; it is connected to an external suction device.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The suction aid does not have a vacuum generating device or a hollow grip portion for guiding exhaust air.

features.item: A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The suction aid does not have a grip portion, nor does it describe any sound-damping devices within its housing.

features.item: A suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to the carrier plate extending around it
features.note: The reference describes a suction aid with a contact surface that rests on a workpiece, but it does not explicitly mention a suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to it.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip
features.note: The reference describes a suction aid and a separate fastening device, neither of which is a grip unit with all the specified features.

features.item: Vacuum handling apparatus with suction plate and grip unit combined
features.note: The reference describes a suction aid and a fastening device, but not a combined vacuum handling apparatus with a suction plate and a grip unit as described.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The suction aid does not have a grip portion, nor does it describe any sound-damping material lining any part of its housing.

features.item: Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: The vacuum generating device is external to the suction aid and is described as a separate suction device (Staubsauger or Industriesauger).

features.item: Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not describe any sound-reducing devices or materials within the housing of the suction aid.

features.item: Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
features.note: The suction aid does not have a grip portion, nor does it describe an elongated structure between housing portions with an air outlet.

features.item: Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The suction aid does not have a grip portion or an internal air collection screw for exhaust air.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
features.note: The suction aid does not have a grip portion or exhaust air baffles as described.

features.item: Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
features.note: The suction aid does not have a battery coupling point or air baffles for directing exhaust air away from it.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference describes a suction aid and a fastening device, but not a grip unit and suction plate releasably connected.

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.note: The reference describes a suction aid with a suction opening and a connection to an external suction device, but not a grip unit with a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate.

claims.note: This reference describes a suction aid for a handheld power tool, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device with a suction plate.

claims.quote: The handheld power tool comprises a drive unit which, in particular, has an electric motor. The drive unit is preferably designed via a gear unit with the tool holder for transmitting a drive movement.
claims.note: The reference discloses a housing and an electrically operated drive unit (which could be a vacuum generating device in a different context), but not specifically a grip portion for gripping a grip unit or a vacuum generating device for a laying device.
The reference describes a housing for a handheld power tool, but does not specify that a grip portion is designed as a hollow body.
The reference describes air ducts for suctioning dust, but not exhaust air from a vacuum generating device being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.

The reference describes a suction aid for a handheld power tool and a fastening device for a suction hose, but it does not mention a grip portion with a sound-damping device or an electrically operated vacuum generating device within the grip portion.
The reference does not describe a grip portion being lined with a sound-damping material.
The reference describes a suction aid and a fastening device, but not a grip unit with a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion.
The reference does not describe a sound-reducing device in a first housing portion or the first housing portion being lined with sound-reducing material.

The reference describes a suction aid for a handheld power tool with a housing and an interface for a suction device, but it does not describe a grip unit with an elongated grip portion between a first and second housing portion, nor an air outlet arranged on the second housing portion.

The reference describes a suction aid for collecting dust, but it does not mention an air collection device in the form of an air collection screw arranged upstream of a grip portion in a first housing portion for collecting exhaust air.

The reference describes air channels and air guiding elements within the suction aid, but it does not describe bent or curved air baffles downstream of a grip portion in a second housing portion for guiding exhaust air to an air outlet.

The reference mentions that a handheld power tool can be a cordless type with a battery interface, but it does not describe a battery coupling point arranged on the second housing portion of a grip unit, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from it.
This reference does not disclose an air baffle for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.
This reference describes a suction aid for a handheld power tool, not a vacuum handling apparatus with a suction plate and grip unit.

This reference describes a suction aid for a handheld power tool, not a vacuum handling apparatus with a grip unit and suction plate.
This reference describes a suction aid for a handheld power tool, not a vacuum handling apparatus with a grip unit and suction plate that generates a vacuum to lift an object.

overall.why: The reference describes a suction aid for a handheld power tool, which is a related field, but it lacks the core features of a self-contained vacuum unit with a hollow grip and sound damping.
